static.preserved_failures: Pre-tool executable permission failure, wrong top library, unsupported local urandom(seed); all records retained, plus pre-flush static pass. Final source has its own completed static snapshot.

launch_conditions: Rehash bound sources/DPI and snapshot before each invocation; no changed-source or snapshot substitutions.
Only one owned Laya workflow heavy tool at a time; unrelated jobs may coexist within unchanged guards.
Run idle first. If idle exits nonzero, triggers a guard, fails any assertion, or lacks a complete valid endpoint, preserve result and do not run traffic.
If idle completes validly, traffic is already authorized once; no additional permission or reviewer turn needed.
No retry, budget extension, third run, or old full Attention execution authorized.
runtime_release.acceptance: Require exit0/no guard/no UVM_ERROR or FATAL/DIAG_INVALID/protocol error, exact endpoint and memory/traffic assertions. PASS marker alone is insufficient. Classify guard interruptions as incomplete.

interpretation_limits: This tests the seven copied m_axi SLAVE environments at the explicit small-page boundary. It excludes the full Attention DUT, two original AXI-Lite MASTER environments and their complete interaction.

Original control polling sequence creates repeated poll objects only after wait(dut2tb_ap_done_kernel==1); the prior phase window never reached kernel_done, so that loop does not explain its observed pre-done growth.

Constructor counter measures constructor requests, not live objects or allocated bytes. Idle/traffic correlations or post-drain plateau cannot establish a particular leak or finite full-run upper bound.
